title: Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
intro: Exponential: f(x)=a^x, a>0, a not 1. Log is the inverse: y=log_a x means a^y=x.

cards.title: Exponential Functions
body: An exponential function is f(x)=b^x with b>0 and b not 1. If b>1 it grows. If 0<b<1 it decays. The graph passes through (0,1).

cards.title: Change of base
body: log_a b = log b / log a. Use the same base on top and bottom.

steps.text: log_2(x-1)=3 means x-1=8, so x=9. Check that x-1 is positive.

cards.title: Logarithms
body: log_b x = y means b^y = x. The log is the inverse of the exponential. Domain x>0.

lessons.title: Applications of Exponential and Logarithmic Functions

cards.title: Growth and decay
cards.problem: 1000 Nfa grows at 10 percent a year. Value after 2 years? 80 g has a half-life of 5 years. How much after 15 years?

Correct idea

cards.title: Unit summary
body: b^x grows if b>1 and decays if 0<b<1. log_b x = y means b^y=x. Product adds logs, quotient subtracts, power multiplies.

questions.q: 80 g, half-life 5 years, amount after 15 years
